missions.name: CropCore - AI-powered Smart Farming Assistant
missions.objective: Develop an AI-driven crop monitoring and smart irrigation system for precision agriculture.
challenges: Weed detection in varying lighting conditions
missions.impact: 95%+ accuracy in disease diagnosis and yield prediction
missions.description: CropCore is an AI-powered smart farming assistant that uses machine learning and computer vision for crop monitoring, weed detection, disease diagnosis, and yield prediction. The system integrates with IoT sensors for real-time irrigation optimization.

missions.name: CareerTrack - AI-powered Career Platform
missions.objective: Build an AI-powered career platform with resume analysis, mock interviews, and portfolio generation.
missions.impact: Prototype ready with live demo available
missions.description: CareerTrack is an AI-powered career platform that provides resume analysis, mock interviews, and portfolio generation using advanced LLM workflows built with LangChain and LangGraph.

missions.name: AutCore - AI-driven Autism Screening Tool
missions.objective: Develop a multimodal AI screening tool for early autism detection using computer vision and speech analysis.
missions.impact: 64% screening accuracy using gaze tracking and speech-disfluency detection
missions.description: AutCore is an AI-driven autism screening tool that uses multimodal analysis combining computer vision for gaze tracking and speech analysis for disfluency detection to provide early autism screening.

missions.name: KRED - AI-powered Financial Intelligence Platform
missions.objective: Build an AI platform for financial behavior analysis and long-term spending insights.
missions.impact: AI-powered financial recommendations with real-time insights
missions.description: KRED is an AI-powered financial intelligence platform that analyzes financial behavior, provides long-term spending insights, and generates personalized financial recommendations using AI.

missions.name: DiscAgeAI - Multimodal Spinal Degeneration Assessment
missions.objective: Develop a multimodal framework combining spinal MRI and biomechanical sensing for spinal degeneration assessment.
challenges: Multimodal fusion of MRI and sensor data
missions.impact: Achieved R² = 0.70 with 2.58-year MAE using 2.5D CNN sensor fusion
missions.description: DiscAgeAI is a multimodal framework that combines spinal MRI and biomechanical sensing to assess spinal degeneration and predict age-related spinal conditions with high accuracy.

missions.name: PACDI - Plant-Adaptive Greenhouse Optimization
missions.objective: Build an adaptive greenhouse system with stress-aware climate control and IoT automation.
missions.impact: Reduced water and energy overuse using ESP32-S3 based optimization
missions.description: PACDI is a plant-adaptive greenhouse optimization system that uses stress-aware climate control and IoT automation to optimize plant growth while reducing water and energy consumption.

missions.name: Diagnosis-Aware Medical Image Encryption
missions.objective: Develop a diagnosis-aware encryption system using fracture detection and selective protection.
missions.impact: 100% reconstruction quality with AES-RSA lossless encryption
missions.description: Diagnosis-Aware Medical Image Encryption is a system that uses fracture detection to selectively protect medical images with AES-RSA lossless encryption, ensuring both security and image quality.

missions.name: SSL-RUL - Self-Supervised Predictive Maintenance
missions.objective: Develop a self-supervised LSTM framework for predictive maintenance using masked reconstruction learning.
missions.impact: Achieved 48.6% RMSE improvement on C-MAPSS with reduced labeled data
missions.description: SSL-RUL is a self-supervised LSTM framework that uses masked reconstruction learning for predictive maintenance, achieving significant improvements on benchmark datasets with minimal labeled data.
